summary: Frontend-only testing of Reviewer Side-Nav + Progress bar + verdict nudge on /review/:slug (auth bypassed). All 6 requested features verified via Playwright on the preview URL. Side-nav renders exactly 18 assigned pages for vishal.k@emergent.sh in assignment order (put-your-app-live first, make-it-yours last), current item highlighted indigo, progress reads '0 of 18 reviewed' with 0% bar. Selecting a verdict incremented progress to '1 of 18 reviewed' (bar 5.55556%), showed 'Verdict saved' toast, and turned the side-nav icon emerald (lucide-circle-check text-emerald-500) live. Header position shows 'N / 18'; prev disabled on item 1, next (header+footer) disabled on item 18. Verdict nudge modal appeared on next-page-btn, next-page-footer, side-nav item click, and back button when no verdict; nudge-stay closed the modal and kept the URL; nudge-review-later navigated to /review/get-your-first-users?reviewer=vishal.k%40emergent.sh. With a verdict set, next navigated directly with NO nudge. Review Console Assignments tab chip (review-page-put-your-app-live) navigated with ?reviewer=vishal.k%40emergent.sh and side-nav populated 18 items. No-reviewer-param case (dev@local, 0 assignments): review-sidenav / review-progress / prev-next buttons are absent, content + verdict + comments rail render in 2-col layout with no layout break. No console errors observed.

issues: 'Stay and leave a verdict' only closes the modal; it does not scroll/focus the verdict chip group, so on long pages the reviewer may not see where to act (minor UX nit).

critical_code_review_comments: ReviewPage.jsx saveVerdict posts as the logged-in user (dev@local in bypass) while progress/verdict reads are keyed to ?reviewer=, so the optimistic increment disappears after reload when viewing another reviewer's queue. Acceptable in bypass mode, but in real auth the ?reviewer param should be ignored (or server-validated) for non-self reviewers to avoid misleading progress.
Verdicts are fetched via a full-project GET /verdicts and filtered client-side; will not scale — consider a reviewer-scoped query param.
guardedNavigate does not intercept browser back/refresh (only in-app controls), so the nudge can be bypassed with the browser back button — expected/acceptable but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: None. One temporary verdict row (reviewer_email=dev@local, doc_slug=put-your-app-live) was created by the verdict click and has been deleted from Mongo; review_verdicts is back to 0 docs. No assignments were modified and nothing was published.
